ascension.awakening.requires_jester_spir: The Unbound Jester demands 1,000,000 spirit damage dealt while shackled.

ascension.cursed_mariner.heart_consumed: The Heart of the Sea dissolves into your cursed form. You have become a Cursed Mariner.
ascension.enchantment.ep_attunement.desc: Item holds a growing EP pool. Spends EP to absorb durability damage, regenerates over time, and gains 2%% of a slain entity's EP on each kill.
ascension.evolution.holy_blocks_demon_lo: A holy soul rejects the demon lord's path.
ascension.evolution.holy_blocks_fallen: A holy soul touched by True Hero's grace cannot fall.
ascension.great_mage.chant.nothing_to_le: No new magic to learn — the chant finds no answer.
ascension.great_mage.tome.no_book: You need a book in the input slot.
ascension.great_mage.tome.title: Tome Creation
ascension.item.skill_stone.unknown: The sealed skill could not be found.
ascension.race.abyssal_dragonewt.descrip: Half dragon, half dimensional horror. Their colossal frame tears space.
ascension.race.angel.description: A winged being of holy light. The first step on the angelic path.
ascension.race.archangel.description: A higher angel commanding sacred aura and divine ki.
ascension.race.ascended_djinn.descriptio: A djinn crossed into divinity, commanding the laws of the world.
ascension.race.beholder.description: Apex of the aberrant lineage. Central eye negates magic; stalks rain devastation.
ascension.race.blood_noble.description: An aristocrat of blood and shadow — charming, near-impervious, master of the night.
ascension.race.bog_ancient.description: A Named Swamp Sovereign of immense age, in tune with the earth itself.
ascension.race.chaos_dragon.description: Sovereign of the void. Reality bends around their presence.
ascension.race.chaotic_deity.description: A Fallen Angel ascended into a force of primordial chaos.
ascension.race.corrupted_dragon.descript: Corruption blossomed into full draconic form. Shadow magic flows in its veins.
ascension.race.corrupted_dragonkin.descr: A Dragonewt touched by the first whisper of demonic corruption.
ascension.race.cosmic_deity.description: A Divine Angel ascended past divinity itself, governing the fabric of the cosmos.
ascension.race.cursed_dragon.description: A Named Corrupted Dragon — its breath is black flame that scorches flesh and soul.
ascension.race.cursed_dreadnaught.descri: A Cursed Mariner hardened by battle. Commands the storm and fractures into shadow.
ascension.race.cursed_mariner.descriptio: A Wight who gave their soul to the cursed sea. Deathless and waterborne.
ascension.race.dark_lord_dullahan.descri: Apex of the warrior path. Mortal Fear, Majesty, and a Multilayer Barrier wreathe the throneless king.
ascension.race.davy_jones.description: Lord of the deep. A True Demon Lord whose will reshapes the ocean.
ascension.race.death_knight.description: Armored death given purpose. Magic Resistance and command of Lesser Undead.
ascension.race.death_tyrant.description: A Beholder who transcended death itself — sovereign of life and void.
ascension.race.demon_dragon_god.descript: Apex of draconic corruption — a god of shadow and flame.
ascension.race.demonic_dragon.descriptio: A Cursed Dragon awakened as a True Demon Lord. Wields darkness absolutely.
ascension.race.divine_angel.description: A Seraphim who walked the hero's path and ascended to true divinity.
ascension.race.divine_king.description: A Monkey King who crossed into divinity.
ascension.race.divine_kitsune.descriptio: An Inari-tier celestial fox transcending the count of tails. Gains Mana Manipulation.
ascension.race.dullahan.description: The headless rider. Physical Attack Nullification and a spectral Skeleton Horse.
ascension.race.elder_bloodfiend.descript: An ancient predator who moves between shadows like a wraith.
ascension.race.elder_lich.description: A skeletal sage of long centuries. Sage skill at Lich-tier mastery.
ascension.race.ender_dragonewt.descripti: A Dragonewt forever altered by the End — scales drink darkness, eyes burn ender flame.
ascension.race.fallen_angel.description: A Seraphim who consumed daemonic remains and fell into corruption. Alignment shifts to Majin.
ascension.race.fledgling_bloodfiend.desc: A newly turned bloodfiend, still raw and hungry.
ascension.race.frog.description: A small amphibian with a knack for water and poison. The first step.
ascension.race.frog_monarch.description: The pinnacle of frogkind. Combines the wisdom of the bog with the corruption of venom.
ascension.race.gauth.description: A lesser beholder of armored body and unraveling eyestalks.
ascension.race.gazer.description: A floating majin of countless eyes, born from the void.
ascension.race.giant_frog.description: A frog grown massive — pure physical force.
ascension.race.infinite_djinn.descriptio: A djinn fused with element, daemon, and dragon essences. Power without ceiling.
ascension.race.kindred_bloodfiend.descri: A bloodfiend who has come into their kin and their craft.
ascension.race.kitsune.description: A Named beastfolk fox spirit awakened to mystical potential.
ascension.race.lich.description: A true necromancer. Spatial Manipulation and Magic Darkness Transform unlock.
ascension.race.lich_king.description: Apex of the mage path. Spatial Domination, All-Seeing Eye, Mortal Fear and Majesty.
ascension.race.mage_skeleton.description: A skeleton schooled in arcane sciences. Magic Resistance, Thought Acceleration, Magic Sense, all four elemental Manipulations.
ascension.race.mindwitness.description: A Spectator that fuses perception with domination.
ascension.race.monkey.description: A clever, nimble beast brimming with potential.
ascension.race.monkey_king.description: A sovereign of beasts, claimed via Royal Blood.
ascension.race.monkey_martial_artist.des: A master of unarmed combat, body forged into a weapon.
ascension.race.monkey_warrior.descriptio: A monkey hardened through battle into raw physical strength.
ascension.race.nine_tail_fox.description: The legendary nine-tailed fox — a true hero of fox-kind.
ascension.race.omniversal_djinn.descript: The pinnacle of djinn existence — authority that permeates every layer of reality.
ascension.race.phantom_corsair.descripti: A dread pirate dissolved into spectral darkness — slips through walls and commands the deep.
ascension.race.phantom_djinn.description: A djinn shed of corporeal limits — a phantom of flickering presence.
ascension.race.poison_toad.description: A toad whose body secretes lethal venom.
ascension.race.primordial_djinn.descript: An original djinn from before civilization. Their presence alone breaks lesser wills.
ascension.race.progenitor_bloodfiend.des: The first and most terrible of all bloodfiends — its will rewrites the laws of death.
ascension.race.royal_djinn.description: A noble djinn blessed with divine ki.
ascension.race.seraphim.description: The peak of angelic existence. Branches into Divine Angel (true hero) or Fallen Angel (consume 10 daemon essences).
ascension.race.six_tail_fox.description: A fox spirit of six tails, brimming with spiritual force.
ascension.race.skeleton_warrior.descript: A skeleton tempered for war. Strengthen Body, Corrosion, Self Regen. No longer burns in sunlight.
ascension.race.sovereign_djinn.descripti: Sovereign of all djinnkind, wreathed in dread majesty.
ascension.race.spectator_gazer.descripti: A Gazer with sharper sight — pierces all falsehood.
ascension.race.sun_wukong.description: The Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Reshapes the laws of the world.
ascension.race.swamp_sovereign.descripti: Ruler of the wetlands, master of water and miasma.
ascension.race.three_tail_fox.descriptio: A Kitsune whose power has bloomed into three tails.
ascension.race.trickster_djinn.descripti: A djinn who has mastered misdirection and trickery.
ascension.race.undead_skeleton.descripti: Bones bound by death. Faster, immune to pain/poison/pierce/paralysis. No need for food. Still burns in sunlight; splits next into Warrior or Mage.
ascension.race.venom_lord.description: A Swamp Sovereign awakened as a True Demon Lord — corruption made flesh.
ascension.race.void_dragonewt.descriptio: A dragonewt flickering between presence and void. Bends space and gravity.
ascension.race.whisper_djinn.description: A newborn djinn of small stature and great magical potential.
ascension.race.wishbound_djinn.descripti: A djinn whose power rivals myth, bound only by the wishes they grant.
ascension.race.zombie.description: A risen corpse — entry to the Undead chain, branching off the Wight race. Pain Resistance and Majin alignment, but burns and weakens in sunlight.
ascension.skill.angel_wings.description: Toggle: glide through the air like an elytra without wings equipped.
ascension.skill.blockade.description: Active: apply Regeneration Suppression to the target you're looking at (≤ 16 blocks) for 10s (20s mastered), force-disabling Self / Ultraspeed / Infinite Regeneration. CD 30s. Auto-learned when Magic Jamming is mastered and you've slain 30 Vexes.
ascension.skill.blockade.no_target: No target in front of you.
ascension.skill.blood_blade.description: Active: fire a crimson blade for 10 blood-attribute damage. Costs 1 HP — pays in blood, not magicule.
ascension.skill.blood_domination.descrip: Toggle: +60% outgoing blood damage (+100% mastered). Evolved form of Blood Manipulation.
ascension.skill.blood_frenzy.description: Toggle: bloodlust state — boosts attack damage and speed, drains your HP per second. Killing blows steal a portion of the victim's max HP back.
ascension.skill.blood_manipulation.descr: Toggle: +20% outgoing blood damage (+40% mastered). Masters slowly while toggled on.
ascension.skill.blood_resistance.descrip: Reduces damage from blood-attribute attacks. Evolves into Blood Nullification with enough use.
This target is too important to eat.
Candy Beam cannot be used on players.
The target is too strong to be turned into candy.
ascension.skill.bubble_majin.description: Passive: +10% magicule regen. Toggle: reflect projectiles back at their source. Modes: Storage (pocket dimension, 81 stacks), Candy Beam (turn a non-player at least 1.5x weaker than you into edible candy that passes their EP and skills to whoever eats it), Regeneration (full HP for 5% max aura).
ascension.skill.bubble_majin.regeneratio: You are already at full health.
ascension.skill.deus_sanguis.bite.no_tar: No target in front of you.
ascension.skill.deus_sanguis.description: Toggle: at night, gain Strength III, Speed II, Haste II. Toggle: melee hits inflict Bleeding 6 for 4s (Bleeding 10 mastered). Modes: Bite (Paralysis IV / Blindness IV / Darkness IV + 20 blood damage on the target you're looking at, 25 mastered, 3s CD), Shift (toggle to half-size with 50% max HP and creative flight, 20s/10s CD), Health Drain (held: drain 10% / 20% of nearby enemies' current HP per second as blood damage in 6 blocks, 30s/10s CD).
ascension.skill.dragon_slayer.descriptio: Toggle: dragons treat you as neutral; your Ice/Fire/Thunder Breath bypass resistances. Grants Ice/Fire/Thunder Breath and Dragon Skin/Ear/Eye automatically. Eating a Dragon Essence permanently adds +20 max HP (uncapped, reset on death). Modes: Dragon Infusion (consume a Dragon Heart in hand for +20,000 EP), Dragon Rage (Strength X for 30s, 60s cooldown).
ascension.skill.energy_charge.descriptio: Hold: regen 5% max magicule/s (7% mastered) at the cost of 1% max aura/s. Auto-learned at 25,000 EP.
ascension.skill.evil_majin.candy.nothing: Nothing in range is weak enough to candy.
ascension.skill.evil_majin.description: Ultimate awakening of Bubble Majin. Toggle: full HP heal every 10s, cleanse all negative effects every 5s, reflect basic projectiles. Modes: Storage, Candy for me! (12-block AOE — turns every entity you're 2x stronger than (5x for bosses) into a single merged Majin Candy that lands in your inventory; copies all skills except ultimates), Hunger (held — pink Gluttony-style predation mist, no corrosion DOT, cost-free).
ascension.skill.eye_of_mind.description: Toggle: 10x learning/mastery rate. Modes: Analytical Appraisal (read the battlefield), Analysis (steal a skill from an enemy), Detrimental Gaze (inflict crippling status), Ray of Death (black beam draining a fraction of target HP per second).
ascension.skill.great_mage.description: Toggle: +19% learning/mastery rate for all skills, plus Chant Annulment for mastered magic. Modes: Magic Chant (learn new magic for XP), Study (steal a skill from a target's mind), Create Tome (turn a learned magic into a tome book).
ascension.skill.hell_passage.blocked: No room to open the portal.
ascension.skill.hell_passage.description: Active: open a Hell Portal in front of you. Costs 10%% current MP. CD 30s (10s mastered). Auto-learned once Gate is mastered and 30 Daemon Essences are consumed from your inventory.
ascension.skill.hyperbolic_passage.block: No room to open the portal.
ascension.skill.hyperbolic_passage.descr: Active: open a white Hyperbolic Portal leading to the Hyperbolic Chamber. Costs 10%% current MP. CD 30s (10s mastered). Auto-learned once Gate AND Sacred Haki are both mastered.
ascension.skill.image_training.already_a: You already have an active training clone.
ascension.skill.image_training.blocked: No room to summon the clone.
ascension.skill.image_training.descripti: Active: summon a shadowy training clone in front of you. Idle until hit; once provoked, fights back with melee that bypasses ALL resistances and nullifications. Killing the clone grants 10%% of your current EP as bonus. Costs 50%% current aura and 50%% current MP. CD 5 min. Lifespan 2 min. One clone at a time.
ascension.skill.imprisoned_jester.descri: Equipped: +20% physical and magic damage, +10% crit (+10% physical / +10% crit mastered). Toggle: reflect 25% of incoming physical damage. Forces your alignment to Chaos. Modes: Chaos Spades (white-flame Soul-damage breath scaling with EP, capped at 10M EP), Explosive Goodbye (below 25% HP, detonate for missing-HP damage to nearby enemies' HP and SHP — kills you).
ascension.skill.imprisoned_jester.explos: You must be below 25% HP to activate Explosive Goodbye.
ascension.skill.intimidating_roar.descri: Active: roar to inflict Fear and Weakness on all enemies within 8 blocks for 6s (10s mastered). 20s cooldown.
ascension.skill.king_of_curses.descripti: Toggle: +15% melee damage and Reverse Cursed Technique (1 HP/2s, 1 HP/s mastered) at the cost of 0.2% max aura/s. Modes: Dismantle (ranged single-target slash), Cleave (radial slash ring), Fuga (massive flame explosion), Malevolent Shrine (15-block / 10s aura-slash domain — 20-block / 15s mastered).
ascension.skill.magic_scribe.description: Press: inscribe a random spell scroll. Level 1 on a 5min cooldown (random level / 2min mastered).
ascension.skill.magicule_attunement.desc: Toggle: +5% magicule regen (+10% mastered). Masters slowly while toggled on. Auto-learned once Energy Charge is mastered and Haki is acquired.
ascension.skill.magicule_dominion.descri: Toggle: +25% magicule regen (+50% mastered). Auto-learned once Magicule Resonance is mastered.
ascension.skill.magicule_nourishment.des: Press: refill hunger and grant saturation for 15% of max magicule (7.5% mastered). 10s cooldown (5s mastered).
ascension.skill.magicule_resonance.descr: Toggle: +10% magicule regen (+20% mastered). Auto-learned once Magicule Attunement is mastered.
ascension.skill.magnetized_vacuum.descri: Active: pull nearby items and XP orbs to you within 8 blocks for 5s (12 blocks / 10s mastered). Costs 2000 magicule (1000 mastered). 20s cooldown (10s mastered). Obtained by using a plunderer skill on an Iron Golem.
ascension.skill.maximum_charge.descripti: Hold: regen 10% max magicule/s (15% mastered) at the cost of 2% max aura/s. Auto-learned at 100,000 EP once Energy Charge is mastered.
ascension.skill.one_who_seals.descriptio: Ultimate awakening of Sealer. Passive: every kill grants +0.5 Max Spiritual HP, capped at +20,000. Modes: Seal (capture mob into stone if 1.5x stronger), Suppress (seal 20% of self or sneak-target's Max EP into a stone), Enough is Enough (steal a random skill — excluding ultimates / magics / battlewills — into a redeemable stone). All produced stones land in your inventory.
ascension.skill.one_who_seals.enough.too: You must be at least 2x the target's EP to seal a skill.
You must be at least 3x the target's EP to seal their Unique.
ascension.skill.prickly_hands.descriptio: Toggle: melee hits inflict Bleeding (tier 1, tier 2 mastered). Direct contact only.
ascension.skill.purple_lightning.descrip: Active: call down corrupted purple lightning. Darkness-flavoured damage that bypasses Darkness Attack Nullification. Radius and damage scale with mastery. Intrinsic to Demonic Dragon.
ascension.skill.sealer.description: Toggle: +100 max spiritual HP. Modes: Seal (trap a non-player at least 1.5x weaker than you into a stone — 30s, 20s mastered), Suppress (bank 20% of your max EP into a stone for later — 30s, 20s mastered), Stored Strength (+0.2 attack damage per use, +0.3 mastered, capped at +20, lost on death — 20s, 10s mastered).
ascension.skill.sealer.seal.too_strong: The target is too strong to be sealed.
ascension.skill.sealer.stored_strength.c: Stored Strength is already at its cap (+%s).
ascension.skill.sealer.suppress.no_ep: You have no EP to suppress.
ascension.skill.slayer_of_dragons.descri: Ultimate awakening of Dragon Slayer. Toggle on for: peace with all dragons; ice/fire/thunder breath bypass resistances; +30 Max HP per dragon essence or Ice&Fire flesh eaten (no cap, removed on death); each dragon kill permanently grants +50,000 Max EP and +1 armor. Modes: Dragon Infusion (consume held Dragon Heart for +40k/+50k EP), Draconic Rage (5 min of Strength XX + Strengthen V + Resistance III), Dragon King Roar (held — fires Ice + Flame + Thunder breaths simultaneously).
ascension.skill.slayer_of_dragons.kill: A dragon falls. +%s Max EP, +1 armor.
ascension.skill.timeless_mage.descriptio: Ultimate awakening of Great Mage. Auto-learns and masters every aspectual and spirit magic; passive chant annulment. Toggle: +29 mastery gain, perfect Analytical Appraisal, magic bypasses resistances, and grants creative flight that Magic Jamming cannot interrupt. Modes: Create Tome / Zoltraak / Magic Dominate.
ascension.skill.toxic_skin.description: Toggle: melee attackers are poisoned for 5s (10s mastered, stronger).
ascension.skill.trash_gamer.description: Equipped: +4 to every mastery point gained on every skill. Modes: Duplication Glitch (dupe held item, costs 50%% current MP, 600s CD; 25%% MP mastered), Buff Glitch (random positive effect for 3 min at level 1–10, 60s CD; 10s mastered), Prodigy (10 min: 1 HP, +99%% dodge, +20%% speed, ×5 outgoing damage to bypass resistances; on end: paralysis 10 for 3 min and full aura/MP drain).
ascension.skill.unbound_jester.descripti: Ultimate awakening of Imprisoned Jester. In-slot: +50%% physical/magic damage, +30%% crit chance for +100%% crit. Toggle: 25%% reflect on all incoming damage; The Bit Goes On — fatal hits become 5s of invulnerable invisibility instead of death (5min CD, drains pools to 5%%). Modes: Chaos Theater (360° AOE, hits HP+SHP, 16-block radius), Curtain Call (current-HP AOE, 16-block radius, hits HP+SHP), Final Punishment (mark target with Sentence — 5%% max HP/sec for 10s, on death absorbs 25%% EP).
ascension.skill.unbound_jester.punish.to: Target is too strong to sentence.
ascension.skill.unbound_jester.unlock.li: The Unbound Jester awaits your awakening.
ascension.timeless_mage.dominate.no_magi: Target knows no aspectual or spirit magic to revoke.
block.ascension.awakening_altar.desc: Center of the Ultimate-skill awakening multiblock. Throw a Catalyst on it, then right-click to ritualize.
block.ascension.deepslate_magic_block.de: Crystal-veined deepslate. Stacked into the Awakening Altar pillars beneath the magisteel caps.
block.ascension.magicule_enhancer.desc: Boosts magicule pool & regen in a 3x3 chunk area. Burns magic crystals as fuel.
death.attack.ascension.purple_lightning: %1$s was struck down by purple lightning
%1$s was struck down by %2$s's purple lightning
death.attack.ascension.zoltraak: %1$s was struck by the great killing magic, Zoltraak
death.attack.ascension.zoltraak.player: %1$s was struck by the great killing magic, Zoltraak, cast by %2$s
death.attack.image_training_truth: %1$s was struck down by their own shadow
death.attack.image_training_truth.player: %1$s was struck down by their own shadow while fighting %2$s
gamerule.doAscensionUltimate.description: If false, the Awakening Altar refuses to absorb catalysts and the awakening ritual cannot be started. Default: true.
item.ascension.area_rune.desc: Extends effect range to a 5x5 chunk area.
item.ascension.aura_rune.desc: Diverts the effect to restore aura of nearby players.
item.ascension.soul_echo.desc: Drops from slain bosses or named creatures with Max EP at or above 200,000. Used in Ultimate Catalyst recipes.
item.ascension.ultimate_catalyst.desc: Throw onto an Awakening Altar, then right-click. The Ultimate awarded is determined by which Unique you have mastered.
